stories.title: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope Captures Eerie Cat's Head
stories.summary: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope’s mid-infrared view reveals intricate structures within the Cat's Head Nebula, traced by the emission from warm dust and carbon-based molecules excited by starlight.

stories.title: NASA’s SpaceX CRS-35 Launch Jellyfish

The light makes the plumes look like a jellyfish in the sky.
